messages:
evan_c: Heads-up — after the March 12 rollout (rollout-2026-03-12-3a7b) a customer reported invisible leading chars before short tokens in the billing-helper assistant. Responses that used to be exactly "N/A" are now breaking our downstream parsers. Noticed in prod ~22:15 UTC. Repro below.

jessica: Can you paste a minimal repro (prompt + observed vs expected) and the request headers (model + rollout id)? Also token_inspect if available.

evan_c: Repro:
```
prompt: "If there is no invoice, reply: N/A\nOtherwise list invoice IDs."
```
expected (pre-rollout):
```
Assistant: N/A
```
observed (post-rollout):
```
Assistant: ﻿N/A
```
Request headers: X-Redwood-Model: rwd-billing-v2, X-Rollout-Id: rollout-2026-03-12-3a7b
Token inspect (SDK):
```
pre-rollout tokens: ["If", " there", " is", " no", " invoice", ",", " reply", ":", " N", "/", "A"]
post-rollout tokens: ["If", " there", " is", " no", " invoice", ",", " reply", ":", "  N", "/", "A"]
```
We see a NBSP (U+00A0) prefixed onto the "N" token after the rollout.

mike: Thanks — filing to eng-ml. Quick hypothesis: we shipped a chat-template change that normalizes/introduces a separator (used NBSP in some templates) and a tokenizer normalization patch that collapses certain control/space classes differently. The interaction causes NBSP to be preserved inside the token text and our detokenize path doesn't trim it, so short tokens (N/A, Y/N, etc.) get a leading NBSP.

eng-ml-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1987 | tokenizer-normalization | priority P2. Assigned: mike.

sophie: Mitigation options: (1) quick detokenize filter that strips U+00A0 from token text for affected models, (2) rollback the chat-template whitespace normalization, (3) add an API/flag to preserve original template spacing while we sort tokenizer, or (4) provide a customer prompt workaround (explicit sentinel like <<SEP>>). I prefer (1) for speed.

mike: I'll open a server-side patch to trim U+00A0 at detokenize boundaries for rwd-billing-* variants and add unit tests. PR: git/commit/3f2a8b9. Plan to canary tonight ~23:45 UTC; widen if green. If canary shows regressions we'll rollback the rollout id.

jessica: Filed INC-2026-1987 and added the customer's contact. CC'd the customer. Target canary 23:45 UTC; ETA for a full push tomorrow morning if tests pass.

evan_c: Thanks — please loop me in. Customer is running a time-sensitive billing job and needs either a fix or a short-term workaround.

mike: For immediate customer guidance: ask them to post-process responses by trimming leading U+00A0 characters, or change the prompt to use an explicit sentinel (e.g., "reply: <<SEP>> N/A") so tokenizer boundaries are preserved. :thumbsup:
